justified_exclusions.rationale: Documented open dict alias (dict[str, Any]); unknown-key rejection is not required on the open dict itself; parent forbid-paths stay strict (PSC G6 / §3.8).
ENV/settings surface (BaseSettings) intentionally uses extra='ignore'; not a YAML pipeline config boundary (PSC G7).

Documented open nested JsonDict on FilterConfigFile: non-executable filters.metadata (registry + local YAML). Unknown-key rejection is not required inside metadata; parent FilterConfigFile extra=forbid still rejects unknown sibling keys (PSC §3.8 / RF-002 follow-up).
Upstream API response / adapter wire DTOs may tolerate extra keys; out of PSC forbid-track (PSC G8). Do not confuse with BaseApiConfig.
